event.distribution_pattern: Product was distributed to five Washington state retail accounts.

products.product_description: Hot smoked Coho salmon; Gold foiled, vacuum packaged units, approximately ¿ pounds each. Adhesive label affixed to front or back of package. Label reads in part, "**Smoked Coho INGREDIENTS, SALMON CURED WITH WATER, DEXTROSE, FLAVORING, SODIUM NITRITE. PROCESSED BY SUNRISE MEATS***PORT ANGELES WASHINGTON***REFRIGERATE BELOW 38 DEGREE***"
products.reason_for_recall: Sunrise Meats is voluntarily recalling one batch of refrigerated, vacuum-packaged hot smoked salmon due to inadequate water phase salt content to control the hazard of Clostridium botulinum growth and toxin formation.
